name: MonarchRegionSelect
title: RegionSelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (a .sheet with a List and .searchable) over supplied, loaded (.task(id:)) or built-in lists; MonarchTextField with .textContentType(.addressState) for a country without a list
summary: A picker for a state, province or territory of a country, from the app's list, an async loader or compact built-in lists, with a text field for countries without a list.
whenToUse: In an address form after the country, so the region matches the chosen country.
whenNotToUse: Not for cities or postal codes; use a MonarchTextField with the matching text content type. For a whole address, use the app's own address search.
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, country: String?, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, regions: [MonarchRegion]? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isClearable: Bool = true, allowsTextEntry: Bool = true, showsCode: Bool = false, labels: MonarchRegionSelectLabels = MonarchRegionSelectLabels(), loadRegions: (@Sendable (String) async throws -> [MonarchRegion])? = nil)
static func fieldLabel(for country: String?) -> String?
struct MonarchRegion: Identifiable { let code: String; let name: String; init(code: String, name: String) }
struct MonarchRegionSelectLabels { init(chooseCountryFirst: String? = nil, textEntry: String? = nil, loadFailed: String? = nil, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels()) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. fieldLabel(for:) gives the country's word, such as State.

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen region's code, or the typed text for a country without a list; nil when empty.

options.name: country
options.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code whose regions are listed, in any case. nil disables the field with Choose a country first. A new country starts a fresh field.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: regions
options.description: The country's regions from the app's own data. They win over the loader and the built-in lists.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds Required to the hint.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Shows a clear button in the field while a region is chosen.

options.name: allowsTextEntry
options.description: Shows a text field when the country has no list; off shows an empty list instead.

options.name: showsCode
options.description: Shows each region's code without the country (CA for US-CA) at the end of its row.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces Choose a country first, Type the region, the load error and the combobox strings; the combobox's empty text is built in as No regions match.

options.name: loadRegions
options.description: Loads a country's regions from the app's service, once per country while the view is shown. Return [] for a text field. It wins over the built-in lists; call builtInRegions(for:) inside it to keep them.

states.name: no country
states.description: A disabled field with the prompt Choose a country first.

states.name: list
states.description: A MonarchCombobox of the regions in their given order.

states.name: text entry
states.description: A MonarchTextField with the prompt Type the region, for a country without a list.

states.name: loading
states.description: The combobox's list shows Loading... while the loader runs.

states.name: load failed
states.description: A MonarchInlineErrorRetry with Couldn't load the regions. and Try again under the field.

states.name: error
states.description: The field border and message use the danger colour, with an icon; the error is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Label, value and border use the disabled roles.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's, or MonarchTextField's for text entry; the load error is MonarchInlineErrorRetry in the danger tone. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The built-in lists are the web's: US, CA, AU, GB and IN with English names. The web's AbortSignal is Swift task cancellation: the load is cancelled when the view goes away or the country changes. On the web a failed load shows the combobox's own Try again; MonarchCombobox has none, so MonarchInlineErrorRetry is shown under the field. MonarchTextField has no required mark, so isRequired applies to the list field only. The country's word for a region is fieldLabel(for:) instead of a field on the list.
accessibility: The field is the combobox's button, or a standard text field, labelled with the label.
With no country the field is disabled and its prompt says Choose a country first.
A failed load is an inline error with a Try again button.
The text field tells AutoFill it holds the state or region of an address.
edgeCases: Changing the country resets the field; the app clears selection itself if it should not carry over.
Supplied and loaded regions keep their order; the built-in lists are in alphabetical order of their English names, as on the web.
A loader that returns [] gives a text field, unless allowsTextEntry is off.
A failed loader is asked again only after Try again.

MonarchRegionSelect(
    "Canton",
    selection: $canton,
    country: "CH",
    regions: [
        MonarchRegion(code: "CH-GE", name: "Genève"),
        MonarchRegion(code: "CH-ZH", name: "Zürich"),
    ]
)
